scope: JKDF2/MotS character, creature, player and weapon modeling; no level design or Discord research.
relationship_to_existing_research: Nineteen forum threads new to the earlier JKE/TDIR/Shred reference, one revisited limits thread, and four additional tutorials; no claim of exhaustive coverage. Concurrent surface research also uses threads 36447 and 41914; deduplicate when combining totals.
discovery_routes: Public web search for model and failure terms
rights: Original summaries and metadata only. No complete copyrighted forum/tutorial text or attachments are included in this public ledger.
general_limits: Historical advice is attributed; requester confirmation is distinguished from independent reproduction.
Full-text reads exclude tutorial pictures, forum attachment files and executable tools.
Normals were included in discovery and current workflow checks, but no new community normals mechanism is claimed from an unverified result.
Static-object LOD threads supply limited diagnostic examples, not level-design or character-threshold recipes.
Third-person preview, normal profile selection, connected-client appearance, SP behavior and POV rendering remain separate evidence.
